option_relations.rationale: Pheochromocytoma-induced cardiomyopathy is a specific type of cardiomyopathy caused by pheochromocytoma, which matches the leaf labels.
Primary Takotsubo (stress) cardiomyopathy is another term for Takotsubo cardiomyopathy, which matches the leaf label.
Pheochromocytoma crisis is a different condition that may cause cardiomyopathy, but it is not directly related to the leaf labels.
Acute pericarditis is a different condition that is not directly related to the leaf labels.
